content:
anya: heads-up: sample-next-starter telemetry shows doubled embed calls when users run the quickstart with LangChain connectors under high concurrency. noticed during workshop run.

kevin: small repro? steps?

anya: clone sample-next, `yarn`, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, then run this script to parallelize indexing: 
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await Promise.all(docs.map(d => c.embeddings.create({ input: d.text })))
```
Repro is flaky but easy to trigger with ~50 concurrent docs.

sam: is this the same as the token-refresh race we fixed earlier or a distinct concurrency dedupe issue?

aditya: logs?

anya: pasted snippet:
```
2026-05-07T11:45:10.101Z INFO sdk auth token expiring
2026-05-07T11:45:10.102Z INFO sdk refreshing token
2026-05-07T11:45:10.210Z INFO sdk refresh ok
2026-05-07T11:45:10.211Z INFO sdk retrying original request attempt=1
2026-05-07T11:45:10.212Z INFO app started embed for doc id=doc-7
2026-05-07T11:45:10.212Z INFO app started embed for doc id=doc-7 (concurrent)
2026-05-07T11:45:10.320Z WARN backend embed throttled status=429
```

kevin: looks like two concurrent calls for same doc id are not being coalesced. Starter should demonstrate `x-redwood-idempotency` or show how to dedupe at application level.

marta: agreed. docs should have a note under "Indexing at scale" and a code snippet for coalescing promises (simple in-memory map) and a LangChain connector example that passes idempotency.

sam: for LangChain, we should set step-level retry=0 in the sample agent and let the SDK handle retries. We should also show how to pass an idempotencyKey into the connector.

aditya: plan: 1) quick starter patch: add small `dedupePromise` util in the sample and wire it into the indexer; 2) SDK change: expose `x-redwood-idempotency` and default to generating per-input key when `REDWOOD_SDK_IDEMPOTENCY=auto`; 3) CI: add a smoke that runs sample indexer with mocked backend and asserts only one embed per doc id.

anya: I'll open the starter PR with dedupe util + docs.

kevin: I'll draft the LangChain sample change and add a small test showing step retry=0 with comments.

aditya: I'll own the SDK flag and server-side dedupe ticket. Also will add conservative jittered backoff when refresh happens to avoid tight retry storms.

ci-bot: ci/workshop-sample job failed earlier; will re-run after PRs.

marta: also add a note in quickstart upgrade guide: "If you're using connectors that may call concurrently, enable idempotency or coalescing."

anya: assigning reviewers: @kevin for LangChain, @marta for docs. Will link to issue #4278 in the PR.

sam: nice. once merged we should run a small cost regression eval to ensure token usage improves.

ci-bot: issue #4278 created for server-side embed dedupe (priority=P2)
